description: Use this only when someone asks about Pulore's own work or experience, for example whether Pulore has built something like their idea. Finds published Pulore case studies related to a topic, matching industry, platform, services and technology tags, and returns each project's summary and link, with timeline, team size and results where the case study publishes them. Searches the case-study files bundled with this server; it does not browse or modify external sites. Returns nothing when no project matches. Don't use it to find examples of other companies' products.

query.description: What the project is about, for example 'health app with HIPAA' or 'Shopify storefront'. Topic words only, no personal details.

name: find_pulore_case_studies
title: Find related Pulore projects
